purpose: Disposition of every money-handling file for the local-edition port. See README.md.

api/_lib/stripe.ts.reason: billing — Stripe revenue, not the user's ledger. PHASE1 §7: "Stays cloud-only, permanently"; invoices.amount is not ported (DESIGN §3.1 row 24). The local edition has no billing surface.

api/account/delete.ts.reason: cloud-only — PHASE1 §7: GDPR erasure is deliberately not the wipe RPC, and locally "erase everything" is `rm wealth.db`. Its dependency, C-5's third condition, is in scope and lives in the migrations.

src/services/api/transactionService.ts.note: Holds D-4's latent third split writer (:916-981), which PHASE1 §7 puts out of scope — the RPC is the specification, not this mirror. The rest of the file is in scope.

src/services/conflictResolutionService.t.reason: phase 2 — PHASE1 §7: dormant (nothing dispatches CONFLICT_DETECTED_EVENT) and Phase 1 has no sync, so there are no conflicts to resolve. TS-C1/TS-C2 become the merge policy in the cloud↔local sync design. Preserve the file; do not port it.

src/services/dividendService.ts.reason: deleted: only reachable from /enhanced-investments, which was removed (its holdings source, Account.holdings, was never persisted)

src/services/enhancedCsvImportService.ts.note: PARTIAL. Its cleared policy (TS-I9, enhancedCsvImportService.ts:417) is ported as ClearedPolicy::NoClearedColumn and proved by admission-specs/cleared-*csv* against THIS service, driven end to end with a one-row CSV. The slash-date question and the default-to-today behaviour (PHASE1-PLAN §4.4, an owner decision) are not ported.

src/services/errorHandlingService.ts.note: Kept visible by hand: discovery reached it only as an import of stockPriceService, which stopped importing it when the quote path moved server-side (/api/quotes). The module itself is unchanged and still classifies and retries financial operations.

src/services/import/msMoney/feedOverlap..evidence: crates/wealth-core/src/admission/feed_overlap.rs — both passes, the handover and its two refusals. 25 admission-specs/overlap-*.spec.mjs against this module, plus crates/wealth-core/tests/admission.rs for the property the differential cannot carry (a feed row with an unreadable date matches nothing; its position in the SORT is undefined in this module, whose comparator returns NaN, so no spec asserts it). One declared divergence: float-drifted amounts.

src/services/import/msMoney/transform.ts.note: PARTIAL. Its cleared policy (TS-I9, transform.ts:328-329) is ported as ClearedPolicy::ReconciledStatus and proved by admission-specs/cleared-*money* against THIS module, driven through transformMsMoneyExport. The rest of the transform is the 1,300-line importer PHASE1-PLAN §3.1 explicitly keeps in TypeScript.

src/services/investmentEnhancementServic.reason: deleted: invented its own ESG scores (Math.random), beta, Sharpe and benchmarks

src/services/offlineDataService.ts.reason: dead code — AUDIT3 §7.2 verified: its only importer (src/hooks/useOfflineData.ts) has zero importers, and it POSTs to /api/transactions|accounts|budgets|goals, none of which exist.

src/services/offlineService.ts.note: Partially dead: AUDIT3 §7.2 verified saveTransaction/updateTransaction/deleteTransaction have no callers and the sync queue POSTs to nonexistent endpoints, but OfflineStatus/SyncConflictResolver are rendered from Layout.tsx. Do not port the queue as if it works.

src/services/ofxImportService.ts.note: PARTIAL. Its cleared policy (TS-I9, ofxImportService.ts:568) is ported as ClearedPolicy::NeverPreCleared and proved by admission-specs/cleared-an-ofx-row-* against THIS service, driven end to end with a one-row OFX file. Everything else — TS-I1 through TS-I5 — is the parse and is not ported.

src/services/portfolioRebalanceService.t.reason: deleted: only reachable from /enhanced-investments, which was removed

src/services/qifImportService.ts.note: PARTIAL. Its cleared policy (TS-I9, qifImportService.ts:104-105 applied at :387) is ported as ClearedPolicy::FileFlag and proved by admission-specs/cleared-*qif* against THIS service, driven end to end with a one-row QIF file. TS-I10 (the date-order inference) and TS-I11 (an unmatched category is left blank) are not ported.

src/services/realtimePriceService.ts.reason: deleted: polled the browser-side Yahoo fetch that CSP and CORS made impossible; superseded by /api/quotes

src/services/stripeService.ts.reason: billing — Stripe revenue, not the user's ledger. PHASE1 §7: "Stays cloud-only, permanently"; invoices.amount is not ported (DESIGN §3.1 row 24). The local edition has no billing surface.

src/services/subscriptionApiService.ts.reason: billing — Stripe revenue, not the user's ledger. PHASE1 §7: "Stays cloud-only, permanently"; invoices.amount is not ported (DESIGN §3.1 row 24). The local edition has no billing surface.

src/services/supabaseService.ts.reason: dead code — PHASE1 §7 and TS-INVARIANTS §5: zero importers; its updateAccount would write a nonexistent camelCase column. A port hazard, not a port target; scheduled for a cloud-side delete PR.

src/services/supabaseSubscriptionService.reason: billing — Stripe revenue, not the user's ledger. PHASE1 §7: "Stays cloud-only, permanently"; invoices.amount is not ported (DESIGN §3.1 row 24). The local edition has no billing surface.

src/utils/accountNumberInput.ts.note: PARTIAL. digitsOnly, keepLastFour, formatSortCode and the two lengths are ported inside crates/wealth-core/src/admission/account_identifiers.rs (proved by admission-specs/identifiers-*). The STORAGE boundary — accountNumberForStorage, accountNumberUpdateForStorage, linkedAccountNumberForStorage — is not, and it is the half D-5 was about: those belong with the account write verbs, which do not exist yet. nextAccountNumberValue and formatCardNumberForDisplay decide what an input box and a screen do.

src/utils/calculations-decimal.ts.note: Split disposition needed: AUDIT3 §4.1 verified 24 of 34 exports have zero callers and contradict incomeExpense.ts, while §4.2 lists seven live budget rules that are NEW and in scope. Do not mark this file out-of-scope wholesale.

src/utils/dateBoundary.ts.note: toDateMs is what statementDuplicates.ts reads a date through, and crates/wealth-core/src/admission/day.rs is the port of the part that matters — the ECMAScript date-only form INCLUDING its rollover (30 February is 2 March, measured). V8 non-standard fallback parsing is deliberately not ported and admission-specs/dedupe-a-date-only-the-browser-can-read-* pins the difference from both sides. normalizeTransactionDates is a read-path helper with no admission decision in it.

src/utils/decimal.ts.note: The money boundary. crates/wealth-core/src/money.rs ports the RULE (TS-M1) and declares the divergence: parseMoneyInput rounds 2dp HALF_UP, Money::parse refuses more than two places. The admission lane now pins that divergence at three further sites (dedupe, bank balance, feed overlap), each from both sides, so the day this module stops rounding the divergence retires deliberately.

src/utils/formatters.ts.reason: deleted: its formatCurrency took Math.abs and never put the sign back, so a debit and a credit of the same size printed identically. Callers now use the signed Decimal formatter in src/utils/currency-decimal.ts. Its other exports (formatNumber, formatCompactNumber, formatBytes) had no callers at all.

src/utils/importDedupe.ts.reason: deleted: its only two callers were the batch importer and the guided import wizard, both of which parsed and wrote transactions themselves instead of using the real CSV/OFX/QIF dialogs. Both are gone; the duplicate rules that survive are statementDuplicates.ts (date+amount+FITID review) and the database's own import-id key.

src/utils/mnyParser.ts.reason: deleted: a byte scanner that swept a .mny for anything decoding as a float and offered the results as transactions, so it invented payments the Money file never held. The real Microsoft Money importer is src/services/import/msMoney, which reads the file's own tables.

src/utils/ofxAccountIdentifiers.ts.evidence: crates/wealth-core/src/admission/account_identifiers.rs — all three exported functions, plus the digitsOnly/keepLastFour/formatSortCode rules it takes from accountNumberInput.ts. 19 admission-specs/identifiers-*.spec.mjs and 7 admission-specs/match-*.spec.mjs against this module. The port adds a candidate COUNT the TypeScript has no counterpart for, declared rustOnly in each spec, so no-match and too-many-matches stay distinguishable.

src/utils/qifParser.ts.reason: deleted: a SECOND QIF parser, reachable only from the retired Legacy Import dialog. The one QIF parser is src/services/qifImportService.ts, which the QIF dialog uses.

src/utils/statementBankBalance.ts.evidence: crates/wealth-core/src/admission/statement_bank_balance.rs, including the BankBalanceUpdates type that makes a balance write unrepresentable rather than merely absent. 18 admission-specs/bankbal-*.spec.mjs against this module, plus the key-set unit test. One declared divergence (a sub-penny closing balance is rounded here, refused there). formatStatementDay and todayIsoDay are deliberately NOT ported: they decide what is SHOWN, which is the other side of the dividing line, and both carry a timezone argument that belongs in this suite.

src/utils/statementDuplicates.ts.evidence: crates/wealth-core/src/admission/statement_duplicates.rs (with day.rs and text.rs, which two modules share). 21 scripts/local-sqlite/admission-specs/dedupe-*.spec.mjs, run against THIS module through scripts/local-sqlite/lib/ts-oracle.mjs, plus crates/wealth-core/tests/admission.rs. Two declared divergences, each pinned from both sides: a sub-penny amount is rounded here and refused by Money::parse, and V8 fallback dates (2027-2-7) are read here and unreadable to the port. exactPence has no counterpart in the port and needs none — the amount is already an i64 of minor units.

src/utils/transferMatch.ts.note: PARTIAL. isSelfTransferCategory (TS-I8) is ported as crates/wealth-core/src/admission/self_transfer.rs and proved by 6 admission-specs/category-*.spec.mjs. findTransferCandidates (TS-T7, #46) and transferCategoryFor are NOT: they are the transfer SWEEP ranking, which PHASE1-PLAN §3.2 routes through plan_transfer_sweep and which reads the whole register rather than one row. The entry stays pending because of them.

supabase/migrations/20260610140000_atomi.evidence: the three ledger verbs it introduced: crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/{create,update,delete}_transaction.rs, and the LIVE definitions each was ported from. crates/wealth-core/tests/{create,update,delete}_transaction.rs (55 tests) and verb-specs/{create,update,delete}-transaction-*.spec.mjs.

supabase/migrations/20260610150000_finan.evidence: U-1 and U-6. write_financial_audit is crates/wealth-core/src/audit.rs, which also carries the local strengthening (a length-prefixed hash chain the cloud has no twin for) and the DECISION about actor_clerk_id. Proved by specs/u2-*, specs/u3-*, specs/u6-*, verb-specs/u1-an-update-writes-one-audit-row-carrying-both-sides-of-the-change.spec.mjs, and every verb spec’s auditShape/auditTrail assertion.

supabase/migrations/20260612110000_updat.evidence: the p_user_id scoping it added is crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/update_transaction.rs; verb-specs/update-transaction-somebody-elses-row-*.spec.mjs and tests/update_transaction.rs::somebody_elses_row_is_refused_by_name.

supabase/migrations/20260613090000_bank_.evidence: both functions. import_bank_transactions_atomic is crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/import_bank_transactions.rs (27 verb-specs/feed-*.spec.mjs + tests/ingest.rs); link_bank_account_snap is crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/link_bank_account_snap.rs (verb-specs/snap-*.spec.mjs + tests/account_snap.rs).

supabase/migrations/20260707120000_recon.note: PARTIALLY ported. Its update_transaction_atomic, create_transaction_atomic and import_bank_transactions_atomic definitions are all superseded and their live successors ARE ported (crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/). set_transactions_cleared is NOT ported and is the whole of what is left here — the bulk reconciliation write, which belongs with the reconciliation surface rather than with the ingest pair.

supabase/migrations/20260708100000_payee.evidence: both functions, each ported from its LIVE successor: apply_category_to_uncategorized (crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/apply_category_to_uncategorized.rs, whose port found the regression this file’s guard was lost to) and import_bank_transactions_atomic (crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/import_bank_transactions.rs). verb-specs/apply-*.spec.mjs, verb-specs/feed-payee-memory-*.spec.mjs.

supabase/migrations/20260708140000_trans.evidence: all three RETURN trigger, and all three are carried by scripts/local-sqlite/schema.sql as C-3, C-4 and C-5 rather than as verbs — nothing in src/ or api/ calls them as functions. specs/c3-*.spec.mjs, specs/c4-*.spec.mjs, specs/c5-*.spec.mjs (7 specs), plus the vacuity table in scripts/local-sqlite/README.md that names which specs fail when each trigger is removed.

supabase/migrations/20260708160000_delet.evidence: crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/delete_unused_categories.rs, ported from the LIVE definition (20260713100000) which recreates this one with one added guard. 18 verb-specs/prune-*.spec.mjs and tests/ledger_core_close.rs.

supabase/migrations/20260709120000_impor.evidence: crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/import_transactions.rs, ported from the LIVE definition (20260808140000) which is this body plus three migrations of additions. 22 verb-specs/import-*.spec.mjs and crates/wealth-core/tests/ingest.rs.

supabase/migrations/20260713100000_trans.note: PARTIALLY ported. delete_unused_categories (its LIVE definition), apply_category_to_uncategorized and protect_split_transaction_fields are all covered — the first two as verbs, the third as schema.sql’s trg_protect_split_* family. set_transaction_splits, the OLDER split writer, is deliberately NOT ported: D-4 records it as a third split writer that the app no longer calls, and set_transaction_splits_with_legs (20260806094058) is the one that is.

supabase/migrations/20260716100000_trans.evidence: all three: link_transfer_pair and create_transfer_counterpart are crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/{link_transfer_pair,create_transfer_counterpart}.rs (the latter ported from its LIVE definition, 20260721090000), and transfer_category_for is crates/wealth-core/src/row/category.rs. verb-specs/{pair,counterpart}-*.spec.mjs and tests/transfer_family.rs.

supabase/migrations/20260721090000_trans.evidence: the LIVE definition of create_transfer_counterpart, and therefore the one crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/create_transfer_counterpart.rs is a port of — T-9’s currency guard included. verb-specs/counterpart-*.spec.mjs.

supabase/migrations/20260721130000_soft_.note: PARTIALLY covered. sweep_reconciled_into_archive is carried by schema.sql as trg_sweep_reconciled_into_archive and proved by specs/a3-reconciling-an-old-row-archives-it.spec.mjs. archive_transactions_before and unarchive_account are NOT ported and are the archive surface, which no Phase 1 verb touches.

supabase/migrations/20260722140000_payee.evidence: both functions. payee_memory_category is crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/import_bank_transactions.rs::payee_memory_category, with the cloud’s three ordering keys plus a fourth the cloud has no rule for (documented, and tested in tests/ingest.rs rather than differentially, because the cloud’s answer below MAX(created_at) is an artefact of its plan). verb-specs/feed-payee-memory-prefers-the-habit-to-the-latest.spec.mjs and the two tie-break specs beside it.

supabase/migrations/20260725120000_audit.note: NOT flipped, deliberately. Its write_financial_audit half is dispositioned — crates/wealth-core/src/audit.rs carries the port and states why actor_clerk_id has no local counterpart (there is no second identity in a file one person owns). Its OTHER half is grants, and a SQLite file has no roles to grant to, so there is nothing to port and nothing to test. Left pending rather than marked ported, because "ported" would claim a test that cannot exist.

supabase/migrations/20260805145035_repai.note: PARTIALLY ported. clear_transfer_links and repair_claimed_transfer are both ported (crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/), with verb-specs/{unlink,repair}-*.spec.mjs and tests/transfer_family.rs. set_transactions_archived is NOT ported — it belongs with the archive surface, alongside 20260721130000.

supabase/migrations/20260805214322_merge.evidence: crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/merge_categories.rs — seventeen refusal sites, sixteen codes, all reachable. 28 verb-specs/merge-*.spec.mjs and tests/category_family.rs.

supabase/migrations/20260806094058_split.evidence: both functions: crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/set_transaction_splits_with_legs.rs (twenty refusals whose ORDER is part of the contract) and crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/link_split_line_transfer.rs (T-10). verb-specs/split-*.spec.mjs and tests/set_transaction_splits_with_legs.rs.

supabase/migrations/20260806180000_sugge.note: PARTIALLY covered. prune_suggestion_dismissals_for_transaction is carried by schema.sql as trg_prune_suggestion_dismissals, and the table with it. What is NOT ported is the canonical dismissal KEY construction (#121): it lives in src/utils/suggestionDismissals.ts, it sorts by UTF-16 code unit rather than by byte, and PHASE1-PLAN §2.4 records it as outstanding. A dismiss_suggestion verb is the work item.

supabase/migrations/20260807083000_user_.evidence: the whole restore family: crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/{user_financial_data_is_empty,wipe_user_financial_data,restore_user_chunk,finalize_user_restore}.rs plus crates/wealth-core/src/backup.rs. update_updated_at_column is a generic stamping trigger and is carried by schema.sql’s trg_*_updated_at family. verb-specs/{empty,wipe,restore,finalize}-*.spec.mjs and tests/restore_family.rs.

supabase/migrations/20260808090000_trans.evidence: both functions carry the ordinal: crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/create_transaction.rs and .../import_transactions.rs, and schema.sql carries the column and its NULLS-LAST index. verb-specs/import-the-statement-order-is-carried-and-absent-stays-unknown.spec.mjs pins all three cases (0, a value, and absent).

supabase/migrations/20260808100000_categ.evidence: all six functions: create_transaction, update_transaction, import_transactions, apply_category_to_uncategorized, confirm_transaction_categories and import_bank_transactions, each in crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/. The three provenance cases are pinned by verb-specs/feed-a-guess-is-a-suggestion-and-a-stated-category-is-not, verb-specs/feed-a-row-with-nothing-to-guess-is-not-a-suggestion and verb-specs/import-a-guessed-category-arrives-as-a-suggestion.

supabase/migrations/20260808140000_file_.evidence: the LIVE definition of import_transactions_atomic, and therefore what crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/import_transactions.rs is a port of — provenance validation, the in-request duplicate refusal, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and {inserted, skipped, idempotent}. 22 verb-specs/import-*.spec.mjs and tests/ingest.rs. The matching UNIQUE index is schema.sql:663 (ux_txn_import_source), non-partial as the cloud’s guard requires.

supabase/migrations/20260808150000_creat.evidence: the LIVE definition of create_transaction_atomic. crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/create_transaction.rs and verb-specs/create-transaction-honours-is-cleared-on-both-engines.spec.mjs, which is the tripwire for the regression this migration repairs.

supabase/migrations/20260808180000_apply.evidence: the LIVE definition of apply_category_to_uncategorized, restoring the guard 20260808100000 dropped. crates/wealth-core/src/verbs/apply_category_to_uncategorized.rs and verb-specs/apply-*.spec.mjs.
